page_title: BOL 1-1 UDI | Bologna v Udinese 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' That's a clear yellow card. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) goes into the book.
90+4' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) strikes the ball from the direct free kick, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save.
90+4' Bologna are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
90+1' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye was alert and made an astonishing save!
90+1' Good work from Bologna as they win a corner.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
88' Here is a change. Dan Ndoye is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
87' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
85' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Substitution. Santiago Castro will be replaced by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
84' It's time for a substitution. Juan Miranda (Bologna) comes on in place of Charalampos Lykogiannis.
82' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Keinan Davis (Udinese) replaces Brenner.
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jordan Zemura (Udinese) for Hassane Kamara.
81' Maria Caputi shows the yellow card to Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) for a heavy challenge.
79' A quickly taken corner by Bologna.
78' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
77' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Bologna out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) is replacing Florian Thauvin.
76' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Nikola Moro is replaced by Michel Aebischer (Bologna).
76' Here comes a substitution. Riccardo Orsolini is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
71' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
71' Santiago Castro (Bologna) latched on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his strike isn't accurate at all and the ball goes way wide of the left post.
68' 1 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
68' Udinese force a corner. They send men into the box.

68' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Lukasz Skorupski to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
67' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) tackles a bit over-zealously and Maria Caputi blows for a foul. No point in arguing there. Udinese will take a penalty kick.
65' A cross into the box from Brenner (Udinese) is cleared.
62' Nikola Moro (Bologna) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
62' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
58' Sandi Lovric comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese).
57' 1 - 0 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Maduka Okoye to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
57' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
57' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty to Bologna!
57' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Bologna as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
55' Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
55' Handball! A player from Udinese handled the ball. It's a penalty to Bologna! Let's see who's going to take it.
55' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Santiago Castro (Bologna) is first to the rebound and sends a header goalwards but it's blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
53' A tremendous drive by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Maduka Okoye makes a brilliant save.

51' Santiago Castro (Bologna) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
49' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Maria Caputi due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) and his team.
48' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
47' It will be a corner kick for Bologna.
47' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' A pass by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
45+4' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+3' Bologna players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
44' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
42' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
41' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
39' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
37' Martin Payero (Udinese) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
35' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) meets a cross inside the box, but Maduka Okoye wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
32' Maduka Okoye (Udinese) receives a yellow card.
31' Close! Dan Ndoye (Bologna) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
30' The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
26' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
26' Dangerous play by Nikola Moro (Bologna). Maria Caputi blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Martin Payero (Udinese) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
22' The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.
18' A cross from a corner kick by Bologna is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
18' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) serves up a nice cross, but Maduka Okoye punches the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bologna are going to take it.
16' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
16' Now Bologna have a corner.
15' Nikola Moro (Bologna) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bologna.
14' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Udinese was in an offside position.
11' Santiago Castro (Bologna) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
11' Nikola Moro (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.

8' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Maduka Okoye thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Bologna will take a corner kick.
7' It's a throw-in for Udinese.
3' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
3' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Udinese.
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Santiago Castro (Bologna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Maria Caputi was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
